snippet.title: Kromlech - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Do you have what it takes to survive in Norgar? You may fall, but you have to rise again! Check out the newest trailer showcasing gameplay elements of Kromlech!

Kromlech is a unique blend of action-adventure, RPG, and immersive sim, enriched with rogue-lite elements. Players can expect an original combat system centered on tactical attacks targeting exposed parts of enemies, a compelling narrative arc, and—above all—a richly atmospheric world inspired by Celtic mythology, offering diverse questing and problem-solving opportunities.

Wishlist the game on Steam! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2406680/Kromlech/

Follow us on Instagram! - https://www.instagram.com/kromlechgame/
